bpd: abbr. barrels per day 桶/日（指產油量）; boxes per day 每日箱數; broncho-pulmonary dysplasia 支氣管肺發育異常
bpi: [計] 位/英寸, 位元/英寸
n a measure of how densely information is packed on a storage medium
bps: [計] 每秒位數, 每秒位元數
n (computer science) the rate at which data is transferred (as by a modem)
<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>電腦／通訊領域的縮寫，用於資料傳輸速度</dd><dt class="w">注意事項</dt><dd class="w">bps 是 bits per second（每秒位元數）；大寫 Bps 通常指每秒位元組，兩者差八倍</dd></dl>
